storage.notes: Default keeps the sample runnable without infrastructure. For the first real deployment, change type to mongodb and supply uri/database. The pipeline writes directly to the selected RegistryStore; exports are optional and are not staging files.

exports.notes: File exports are optional review/interchange products. Set enabled:false for a database-only run.

method_profiles.notes: Assign reusable preservation method profiles by format family/domain. This does not create bespoke methods per file format.

sources.notes: QNL is treated as one institutional profile. The core adapter is institution-neutral; field_map values must match workbook headers and fail loudly if renamed. Multiple candidate headers may be supplied for one logical field.
